# restate_cloud_account (Data Source)

Read-only state of the Restate Cloud account the provider is configured for.

The provider does not manage accounts, billing, or subscriptions: those operations require an interactive user identity. This data source exists so a configuration can read the account's billing mode -- which decides whether a tier change can complete without a browser -- and enumerate the environments the account already has.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read-only account state. The provider does not manage accounts, billing, or subscriptions: those
# operations require an interactive user identity.

data "restate_cloud_account" "current" {}

output "billing_mode" {
  value = data.restate_cloud_account.current.billing_mode
}

output "free_environments_remaining" {
  value = try(
    data.restate_cloud_account.current.free_environment_limit.limit -
    data.restate_cloud_account.current.free_environment_limit.usage,
    null,
  )
}

# A stripe-billed account may be redirected to an interactive Stripe checkout when an environment's
# tier changes, which Terraform cannot complete. Warn at plan time rather than failing mid-apply.
check "tier_changes_are_non_interactive" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.restate_cloud_account.current.billing_mode != "stripe"
    error_message = "This account is billed through Stripe, so a tier change may require completing a browser payment flow. Change the tier in the Restate Cloud console, or switch the account to account billing."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `billing_mode` (String) How the account pays: `stripe` or `account`. Empty when the API reports none.

A `stripe`-billed account may be redirected to an interactive Stripe checkout when an environment's tier changes, which Terraform cannot complete. Check this before planning a tier change.
- `environments` (Attributes List) Environments in the account. This is a summary: it carries no provisioning status and no connection metadata, because the account API does not report them. Use the `restate_cloud_environment` data source for those. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `free_environment_limit` (Attributes) The account's free-environment quota and current usage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--free_environment_limit))
- `id` (String) The account ID the provider is configured with.
- `subscription_current_period_end` (Number) End of the current billing period, as Unix seconds. Null when the account has no subscription.
- `subscription_current_period_start` (Number) Start of the current billing period, as Unix seconds. Null when the account has no subscription.
- `subscription_status` (String) Subscription state: `AWAITING_PAYMENT`, `ACTIVE`, or `INACTIVE`. Empty when the account has no subscription.

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Environment ID.
- `name` (String) Environment name.
- `region` (String) Region the environment runs in.
- `tier` (String) Environment tier.


<a id="nestedatt--free_environment_limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `free_environment_limit`

Read-Only:

- `limit` (Number) Free environments permitted.
- `usage` (Number) Free environments in use.
